fields.Name: T087 - Credential Types Master-Detail Schema
fields.Description: Parses each credential type's FieldSchema JSON into a field list with secret/required badges in a bespoke master-detail layout — a code path absent from every other area.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and choose 'Credentials', then open the 'Types' section. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. Types are grouped under category headers in the left list. Click a credential type. Verify a detail panel opens on the right showing the type's stats (Credentials / Active counts) and a 'Field Schema' section listing the type's fields with badges (data type, plus 'Secret' / 'Required' where applicable). If no types exist, a valid empty state is acceptable success.

judgeValidationCriteria: Types are grouped under category headers in the list
Clicking a type opens a detail panel containing a 'Field Schema' section
Schema fields display type / Secret / Required badges (or a 'No fields defined' note), OR a valid empty state renders when no types exist
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
